answer: Funding-trail clustering: each identity's first stake must arrive through a traceable path recorded on an ivory ledger that is never pruned. Every beacon epoch, graders recompute clusters, and attestations from keys whose funds trace to the same source wallet within three hops count as one vote. A farm spinning up a hundred keys from one treasury leaves a warm ember trail back to it, so its hundred votes collapse to one, while independent agents keep full weight. Beating it means sourcing capital separately for every clone.
